environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 instance with direct PostgreSQL 14 connection (no connection pooler). Application listens on port 8080 exposed via public ALB with no path-based routing restrictions. No network segmentation between application tier and database. Debug endpoints accessible without authentication. Environment variables DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_NAME set; credentials passed per-request via X-DB-Credential header.

config.network: Public ALB -> EC2:8080, no path restrictions
